_comment: Orchestrator decisions applied by inventory_tool/apply-decisions.ps1. Evidence for each decision is in VERIFICATION.md (orchestrator reruns and source checks) and verification-source-findings.md (independent source verification). Findings not listed keep their status, except that every remaining pending-review finding is accepted when its package rerun or the source verification confirmed it (default_pending).

default_pending.verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

misc-005.note: Verification: scoped to the incular-widgets RawAutocomplete; incular-controls has an options query surface. P1 -> P2.

misc-006.note: Verification: InheritedModelData::update_should_notify allows a custom predicate. P2 -> P3.

misc-007.note: Verification: validator and on_saved are silently dropped (forms.rs:452-523), but GenericFormField is a less common typed-field API. P0 -> P1.

misc-010.note: Verification: the finite-size assertion (incular-core geometry.rs:26) is deliberate API design. P2 -> P3.

misc-012.note: Verification: generic serde Restorable<T> (incular-runtime restoration.rs:1120) restores enums and DateTime; only named aliases and Listenable/ChangeNotifier restorables are missing. P2 -> P3.

misc-014.note: Intentional design: ARCHITECTURE.md principle 8 states Flutter is not a requirement to reproduce Dart lifecycle patterns. Observable lifecycle-dependent behavior is covered by other findings.

semantics-016.note: Duplicate of text-003 (WidgetSpan child replaced by plain text); same root cause.

gestures-007.note: Verification: right-click context menus exist in incular-controls (context_menu Trigger); the gap is the neutral GestureDetector callbacks.

paint-009.note: Verification: CustomPainter::should_repaint exists (custom_paint.rs:8-10); only foregroundPainter/child layering is missing.

paint-018.note: Verification: radial focal parameters exist; only GradientTransform is missing.

semantics-010.note: Verification: IndexedSemantics is a collection index, not a sort key; the missing sort-key claim stands.

semantics-012.note: Verification: MergeSemantics exists; container and explicitChildNodes are what is missing.

slivers-008.note: Verification: FloatingHeaderSnapConfiguration is Material (material/app_bar.dart:1354); the widgets-layer gap is snapMode.

text-017.note: Not accepted: in the harness Flutter does not restore text on ctrl+z (text_length 2 vs 3 at 680 ms in both undo twins), which contradicts Flutter UndoHistory behavior in real apps. The twins are therefore not shown to be equivalent (likely an UndoHistory activation or key-routing difference in flutter test). Kept as an open question in SUMMARY.md.

text-018.note: Duplicate of text-005: the multiline twin differs only in the pre-focus selection (frames 0-1); vertical and document movement match from frame 2.
